prompt: Match each Redis Cloud security feature to what it controls.
explanation: Each feature defends a different layer: the allow list filters who can reach the database at the network layer, TLS encrypts the connection in transit, mutual TLS also verifies the client's certificate, RBAC scopes which commands and keys each database user can use, and encryption at rest protects the data Redis writes to disk.

pairs.right: Which source IP addresses or subnets may connect
Encrypts the client-to-database connection in transit
Requires clients to present a certificate the database trusts
Which commands and keys each database user may use
Protects data as it is written to disk
